title: WARRANT common definitions
description: Shared enums, identifier patterns and policy fragments reused by every kernel document schema. This file is not a document schema: it MUST NOT appear in the `$schema` field of a WARRANT file.

change_state.description: Lifecycle state of a Change (02 section 2).

evidence_status.description: Status axis of an evidence record (02 section 2).

gate_verdict.description: Verdict axis of a gate (02 section 2). There is no INCONCLUSIVE verdict.

controller_action.description: Action axis of the controller decision table (02 section 2).

waiver_state.description: State axis of a waiver (02 section 2).

risk_level.description: Aggregate risk level derived from the risk dimensions (05 section 4).

risk_dimension.description: Name of one of the five risk dimensions (05 section 4).

data_loss.description: Values of the `data_loss` risk dimension, ascending; UNKNOWN is always allowed.

reversibility.description: Values of the `reversibility` risk dimension, ascending; UNKNOWN is always allowed.

blast_radius.description: Values of the `blast_radius` risk dimension, ascending; UNKNOWN is always allowed.

security_impact.description: Values of the `security_impact` risk dimension, ascending; UNKNOWN is always allowed.

compatibility.description: Values of the `compatibility` risk dimension, ascending; UNKNOWN is always allowed.

transition.description: Change transition key of the form `<FROM>-><TO>` over the change_state enum.

kebab_path.description: Slash-separated kebab-case path, for example `customer-search` or `data/contracts`.

semver_range.description: Semantic version range accepted by npm-style resolvers, for example `^0.1`, `>=0.1 <0.2` or `1.13.x`.

sha256.description: Content hash in the form `sha256:<64 lower-case hex digits>`.

area.description: Capability area code: 2 to 5 upper-case latin letters (ADR-0012).

relative_path.description: Path relative to its owning directory: no leading slash and no `..` segment.

level.description: Verification level: L0 (structural), L1 (executable), L2 (LLM judgement).

attestation_type.description: Who vouches for the provenance of a record (06a section 3).

overrides_ref.description: Reference `<pack>:<id>` to the pack object this local object replaces (08 section 4).

policy_body.description: Policy fields shared by profile and overlay (05 section 3 and 4).

artifacts.description: Artifact requirements contributed by this policy layer.

required.description: Artifact ids that MUST exist before the guarded transition.

recommended.description: Artifact ids that are reported but do not block a transition.

forbidden.description: Artifact ids that MUST NOT be produced under this policy.

gates.description: Gates required per transition; the key is a `<FROM>-><TO>` transition.

^(PROPOSED|SPECIFIED|APPROVED|IMPLEMENTI.description: Gate ids that MUST pass for this transition.

capabilities.description: Capability restrictions contributed by this policy layer.

forbidden.description: Capability names that agents MUST NOT use, for example `PRODUCTION_WRITE`.

approvals.description: Human approvals required at specific transitions.

role.description: Role name resolved through `roles` in the project config.

at.description: Transition at which the approval is required.

evidence.description: Evidence requirements contributed by this policy layer.

required.description: Evidence kinds that MUST be present.
